Shared Skills and personal philosophy

Home · Formation Skill · 简体中文

Prometheus2Heraclitus is the collection. Its Yinyang formation Skill is SKILL.md, supported by design-and-revision.md, harness-adaptation.md, and reading-map.md under that Skill's references/. The nested docs/ and diagrams/ directories are Yinyang accessories in that same complete package. The collection root is not itself a Yinyang Skill.

Shared Skills offer capabilities and materials to adopt and rework. A personal philosophy develops from one's own experiences, questions, sources, and practice. Yinyang is one developed example: readers may begin with it, combine other ideas, and create work with different names, concepts, and organization.

Philosophy is replaceable; personal accounts must be formed anew. You may retain the five-file structure while replacing the philosophy with your own thought or an evidence-grounded model of a philosopher's thought. Philosophy, imagery, and essays serve the modeling of an actual person and counterpart relationship; if you retain this structure, all five files must describe the real user and their collaboration. A philosopher's thought model cannot replace the user's personal model. Maintain revised philosophy in your own version without overwriting it with the common-file updater. Byte parity applies to copies opting into this repository's continuing common-content updates.

The maintained Yinyang implementation below illustrates one concrete approach. The example and commons essay explains the broader invitation to adopt, combine, or independently reauthor its philosophy and form. Technical paths below support this implementation, not a universal literary format. A differently authored work maintains its own coherent source and references; the common-file updater below is not for that work.

The public website provides reading and file browsing; complete Skills are available from the public GitHub repository. Clone it or download the repository ZIP and retain the complete directory of the package you need. Original Yinyang material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while the other independent Skills retain their package-local MIT licenses. Use and sharing follow each material's existing license and attribution terms; see the collection guide.

Obtain the complete skills/yinyang/ directory and make it available through the consumer's actual Skill mechanism. This supplies a formation method, not a ready-made personal relationship. The consuming model reads the entrypoint, inspects authorized actual environment and relevant psychological or preference material, and helps write the person's philosophy and situated relations at their private owning location. It then realizes the supported understanding in the actual environment, within the task's authority, and verifies the result.

Distributed and situated editions of this maintained implementation have the same structure and byte-identical common content. The common main SKILL.md carries purpose and reading routes; the main conversational model reads it with the complete encounter, user model, and counterpart model, situated use, and source index before substantive work, in both Codex and private Web ChatGPT. Reuse complete current text already in context. The five fixed situated slots have the same names and roles in both packages:

Adopting this implementation requires rewriting all five files below from formation guidance into your own grounded accounts, and organizing the relevant private material in references/personal/. This is necessary formation work, not optional cosmetic customization. The model writes from authorized evidence; the user need not maintain the files personally. Unsettled relations may remain explicitly unknown; a complete autobiography or psychological theory is not required.

Slot Situated content
references/encounter.md A condensed usable account of the actual encounter.
references/models.md The developed user model.
references/relationship.md The counterpart model and their relationship.
references/usage.md Use in the actual environment and allocation of work.
references/sources.md An index of source owners and private provenance.

In the distributed package these files contain formation instructions. In a situated package the consuming model writes grounded actual accounts in them. Formalized user accounts are personal information too; notation does not make them common content. The design reference explains formation and revision. Do not copy the author's portrait or invent a substitute. An existing personal philosophy retains its grounded content when using this same format; it is not replaced with generic instructions.

Private supporting materials belong under references/personal/. These pages record provenance and private material omitted from the common essays. The philosophy remains one authored body even when written by this person; do not reproduce it as a second personal application. A topic companion links to its common text and records its actual sources and privacy boundary. Create one when it carries useful evidence, not an empty copy for every essay. Their filenames follow the evidence; this does not create a different schema. Private content is not committed back into the shared collection.

At completion, check that all five files coherently describe the actual person, counterpart, relationship, and environment; that necessary private materials and provenance are reachable; and that the conversational model can read and use them at the actual entrypoint. Merely downloading, retaining generic guidance, or copying someone else's portrait does not complete a situated version. After initial formation, revise what actual collaboration changes; each update need not rewrite every file.

All other material is common: documents, diagrams, design-and-revision.md, harness-adaptation.md, reading-map.md, package administration, READMEs, and the OpenAI YAML adapter. The shared GitHub package is the canonical common owner. scripts/sync-common.py checks projection by default; --apply projects common source into the target while preserving all five slots and everything under references/personal/. Native owners realize the projected source in local and private Web consumers. It never exports personal content and is not a service or automatic personal upload. Later common edits therefore remain shared rather than forking into separate local and distributed instructions.

Run the source comparison with explicit package directories:

python3 /path/to/shared/yinyang/scripts/sync-common.py \
  --source /path/to/shared/yinyang --target /path/to/situated/yinyang

Add --apply to copy changed common files, then run the comparison again. Start a new situated package from a complete shared copy before filling its personal files. Unmatched target files and common-path symlinks stop the command before copying; inspect their ownership instead of silently deleting them. The command updates source packages only; use the host's existing owner for runtime installation and cloud publication.

The essays in references/docs/ explain the ideas that inform formation. Their relation is described on the homepage; they are not additional Skills or a linear installation sequence. No fictional mini package or calculator stands in for the personal formation and actual environment work.
